description: A multi-agent simulation in which user agents with diverse, data-driven profiles generate star ratings and review texts for items (products, books, businesses) across different platforms (Amazon, Goodreads, Yelp). The simulation uses LLM-based reasoning agents to produce contextually appropriate and sentiment-aligned reviews, leveraging empirical user/item data and platform conventions.

behaviors.name: decide_to_review
behaviors.description: User agent decides whether to review an item based on their review tendency, past behavior, and platform norms.
behaviors.algorithm: Sample a Bernoulli variable per user-item event with probability determined by global probability_of_review, modulated by user’s review tendency.

behaviors.name: assign_star_rating
behaviors.description: User agent determines the star rating for an item, factoring in user bias, item attributes, and platform rating norms.
behaviors.algorithm: Star rating predicted using preference model (e.g., weighted average of user bias, item average, platform norm, and item-user match score).

behaviors.name: write_review
behaviors.description: User agent generates a review text, aligned with the sentiment of the assigned star rating and referencing item attributes.
behaviors.algorithm: Prompt LLM-based reasoning agent with user profile, item attributes, and assigned star rating to generate review text consistent with platform conventions and sentiment alignment.

behaviors.name: receive_review
behaviors.description: Item entity receives a review and updates its review count and average rating.
behaviors.algorithm: Increment review_count; update current_star_rating as running mean.

interactions.name: user_reviews_item
interactions.description: A user agent reviews an item, generating a star rating and review text, which are then recorded by the item entity.
interactions.trigger: per simulation step or per user-item event
interactions.effect: Item's review count and average rating updated; review text stored in user and item history.

environment.time_unit: step (abstracted; could represent a review event or daily batch)

algorithms.LLM_review_generation: Prompt-based LLM call using user profile, item attributes, platform style, and assigned star rating to generate review text with controlled sentiment and relevance.
algorithms.Preference_modeling: Combine user bias (average_stars), item features, and platform norms for probabilistic star assignment.
algorithms.Platform_adaptation: Adjust review length, tone, and rating prior based on platform (using empirical statistics).
algorithms.Memory_management: Memory agent retrieves relevant user/item/review histories and profiles as context for reasoning agent.

data_sources.name: user_sample.json
data_sources.purpose: Initialize user agents with realistic profiles and behavioral tendencies.

data_sources.name: item_sample.json
data_sources.purpose: Initialize item entities with metadata, attributes, categories, and platform.

data_sources.name: review_sample.json
data_sources.purpose: Provide historical review data for memory agent and calibrate agent activity, rating, and sentiment patterns.

data_sources.name: yelp_train_sample.json / amazon_train_sample.json / goodreads_train_sample.json
data_sources.purpose: Calibrate platform-specific rating and review norms; validate simulation outputs.

files.name: main.py
files.description: Entry point; manages simulation loop and orchestrates agent interactions.

files.name: agents.py
files.description: Defines User, Item, PlanningAgent, MemoryAgent, ReasoningAgent classes and their behaviors.

files.name: environment.py
files.description: Defines the environment/network and manages agent/item registration.

files.name: data_loader.py
files.description: Handles loading, parsing, and preprocessing of all data sources.

files.name: llm_interface.py
files.description: Abstraction for LLM-based review text generation and rating reasoning.

files.name: metrics.py
files.description: Implements evaluation metrics (MAE, review quality, distribution comparisons, etc.).

files.name: config.py
files.description: Holds parameters and configuration options for the simulation.

evaluation_metrics: Preference Estimation (1 - MAE of star ratings vs. ground truth)
Review Generation (1 - (Emotional Tone Error * 0.25 + Sentiment Attitude Error * 0.25 + Topic Relevance Error * 0.5))
